Agent Name: Reviews_Expert
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Fabricated “manual” data and selected trails (Mist Trail, Vernal & Nevada Falls via Mist Trail, Upper Yosemite Falls) that are not fully wheelchair accessible, failed to verify “at least three” wheelchair-accessible recommendations on TripAdvisor, and used AllTrails stats instead of TripAdvisor (violating the review-count source constraint). This led to an incorrect final list; the correct accessible waterfall trails are Yosemite Falls (Lower Yosemite Fall) and Bridalveil Fall.
